_comment: Starter template for AuraMCP's MCP config. AuraMCP auto-registers itself in LM Studio on launch, so this template is only needed for manual setup or non-auto-detected hosts. Replace C:\path\to\AuraMCP.exe with the actual install path (shown in the AuraMCP control panel). Replace C:\path\to\your\workspace with the empty directory the agent will populate on first boot. On Windows use double backslashes in JSON strings: 'C:\\Users\\you\\workspace'. On Linux/macOS use forward slashes: '/home/you/workspace'. ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY is only required if you use the 'anythingllm' tool (chat export); you can also drop it in api-key.json instead.
